evaluation.comparison_note: A/B/C reuse the approved paired V1 failure-audit artifact; D uses the same ETH split, seed set, metric code, coordinate conversion, Stage-A checkpoint and coverage protocol. Seed-2035 current-run tensor parity and unchanged candidate/goal checks provide the hard invariance evidence. interpretation.C_to_D_real_gain: No material additional gain is established: D is within 0.30% of C on every reported metric, with small improvements in minADE, minFDE, JFDE and Relative Motion and a negligible JADE worsening. The main benefit is the component-relative projection itself; D supplies a formally trained, deployable realization that satisfies the predeclared adoption signature.
interpretation.joint_quality: D is +0.429% JADE versus Stage A but -0.267% versus V1; JFDE improves 0.533% versus Stage A and 0.783% versus V1.
interpretation.marginal_quality: Substantially recovered but not exactly equal to Stage A: D retains +0.636% minADE and +0.259% minFDE gaps while recovering 59.92% and 79.38% of V1 harm.
interpretation.v2b_reason: V2-A passed the predeclared adoption signature. The weighted relative gradient remains small (mean 1.775% of diffusion), but V2-B eligibility requires a correctly enforced V2-A with no clear trajectory gain; that premise is not met.
